executiveSummary: The Authority remains operationally ready for the 2026 hurricane season, with no identified threats to overall system integrity. LPV-111 remains a major leadership focus, with interim sand/HESCO basket protection installed following identification of landside levee slide progression, and USACE confirming the levee remains capable of performing as designed prior to overtopping. Safety remains Green with zero recordable accidents, staffing remains Amber with 45 vacancies, and the media environment remains Amber due to increased attention on agency operations and governance.
maintenanceActivities: Routine levee, floodwall, floodgate, valve, facility, and equipment maintenance continued with no impacts to system readiness.
Annual floodgate inspections remain up to date; Q3 valve inspections and exercises are underway and progressing on schedule.
Field safety checks, required training, facility preparation, and seasonal readiness activities continue during hurricane season.
Facility repairs, warehouse system maintenance, and support infrastructure improvements remain ongoing.
Turf maintenance is slightly behind due to recent rain but catching up as weather conditions improve; no readiness impacts reported.
Interim sand/HESCO basket protection along the crown of the levee at LPV-111 slide locations has been installed.
